# Game assets

Sprites and sounds from [samuelcust/flappy-bird-assets](https://github.com/samuelcust/flappy-bird-assets), commit `48937b0dfe094da66e38fa3bcffcbf5ad1cd5454`.

Files are unchanged from the source. The repository’s MIT license is included in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Flappy Bird was created by Dong Nguyen. This project is an unofficial recreation.
